name: pov-fuel-distribution-id
description: The Indonesian demo conversation for the fuel distribution sample, asked in one session in this order. The numbers come from samples/fuel_distribution/data (run expected_answers.py): 4,996,168 KL over 200,000 LO, late rate 16.07% over 199,689 finished LO, Papua Maluku 34.54%, DODO 19.53%, subsidised share 49.78% of all volume, Biosolar Sulawesi 114.74% of quota in Oct 2026. The data ends on 2026-10-31.
